PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

  ?person wdt:P39 wd:Q1390748 .
  ?person rdfs:label ?personLabel .
  FILTER(LANG(?personLabel) = "en")
}
GROUP BY ?person
HAVING(COUNT(?award) = 10)
